items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag rejection
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Familienkasse Muster-Mitte, Postfach 44 01, 34002 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 21.11.2025, posted that day. Familienkasse deciding on Kinderzuschlag is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so the 4-day delivery fiction applies without the tax-law weekend/holiday shift: 21.11.2025 + 4 days = Tuesday 25.11.2025 (delivery day). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts the day after delivery (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 25.12.2025. That day is Christmas Day (nationwide holiday); 26.12.2025 is also a nationwide holiday (2nd Christmas Day); 27.12 (Sat) and 28.12 (Sun) follow. Per § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the period end moves to the next working day: Monday 29.12.2025.
